xwikidoc.title: OA 用户数据同步
xwikidoc.content:
{{velocity}} == OA 用户数据同步 == (% class="xform" %) * **数据日期**：默认同步前一天（`xwiki.oa-sync.source..date-offset-days`） * **定时**：每天 05:00，可在「应用 → Scheduler」修改 cron * **记录**：每种来源保留最近 10 条 * **状态说明**：SUCCESS=全部成功；PARTIAL_FAILURE=部分失败；FAILURE=整体失败（详见 errorLog） == 手动触发 == {{html}}
{{/html}} == 最近同步记录 == #set ($records = $services.query.xwql('from doc.object(OASync.SyncRecordClass) as records order by doc.creationDate desc').execute()) #if (!$records || $records.size() == 0) {{info}}暂无同步记录。{{/info}} #else |=(% scope="col" %)类型|=(% scope="col" %)数据日期|=(% scope="col" %)触发|=(% scope="col" %)状态|=(% scope="col" %)总数|=(% scope="col" %)成功|=(% scope="col" %)失败|=(% scope="col" %)开始时间|=(% scope="col" %)错误日志 #foreach ($name in $records) #set ($recordDoc = $xwiki.getDocument($name)) #set ($recordObj = $recordDoc.getObject('OASync.SyncRecordClass')) #if ($recordObj) |$recordObj.getValue('syncType')|$recordObj.getValue('syncDate')|$recordObj.getValue('triggerType')|$recordObj.getValue('status')|$recordObj.getValue('totalCount')|$recordObj.getValue('successCount')|$recordObj.getValue('failCount')|$recordObj.getValue('startTime') #if ("$!recordObj.getValue('errorLog')" != '') |(% colspan="9" %){{code}}$recordObj.getValue('errorLog'){{/code}} #end #end #end #end {{/velocity}}
